## Problem

What developer workflow or debugging problem would this solve?

## Fit for current alpha

SocketLens is currently focused on local WebSocket debugging, onboarding clarity, stability, and trustworthy open-source release quality.

- [ ] This improves Demo, Direct, Proxy, replay, sessions, settings, docs, tests, or release readiness.
- [ ] This does not require accounts, telemetry, cloud sync, billing, or an enterprise proxy platform.

## Proposed solution

Describe the behavior you want SocketLens to support.

## Capture mode or area

- [ ] Investor Demo Mode
- [ ] Demo mode
- [ ] Direct Mode
- [ ] Proxy Mode
- [ ] Packet timeline
- [ ] Payload inspector
- [ ] Manual send/replay
- [ ] Sessions
- [ ] Settings
- [ ] AI
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Alternatives considered

What workarounds or different designs have you considered?

## Open-source impact

How would this help new users, contributors, or maintainers?

## Contributor fit

- [ ] This could be a good first issue.
- [ ] This likely needs maintainer design discussion first.

## Additional context

Add screenshots, sketches, protocol examples, links, or sample payloads if useful. Remove secrets and private data before posting.
